title: Passing an object from one hand to the other by about 9 months
summary: Most children move a thing from one hand to the other by about 9 months.
body: The Centers for Disease Control and Prevention 9-month movement list includes moves things from one hand to her other hand. Passing an object across the midline of the body is the skill that wording names. The page places it with what most children do by nine months. This card is that pass, not a grip of a tiny bit of food, which is a later list. The month is the US Centers for Disease Control and Prevention figure, and other lists can differ. Transfer across the midline is the nine-month hand item. Midline transfer of an object is the nine-month hand item on that page.
